_rule: When sources disagree, the most recent note wins. Overrides hold corrections to catalog.json and the media of each entry.

pc-moon.progress_basis: Comfortably playable on ndskit, in a window in real time, picture and sound matched to melonDS; mouselook and PC shooter keys are next.

pc-nostalgia.progress_basis: Comfortably playable on ndskit: the prologue, the first dungeon and its battles and on; nobody has played it to the end yet.

pc-lufiacots.progress_basis: Comfortably playable on ndskit: fights, drops, chests, menus, saving and loading; nobody has played it to the end yet.

pc-immercenary.progress_basis: Begun as reverse-engineering notes before 3dokit existed, now a static recompilation: logos, films, menus, the city with sound, death, debrief and a second jump play. The speech program is not in the build yet.

pc-ragnarokodysseyace.progress_basis: Begun as format and tooling work before ps3kit existed, now a static recompilation that plays: menus, character creation, saves, the first quests and their monsters at 30 frames.

dc-lba2.progress_basis: V0.9 alpha, running on a real Dreamcast: the first island plays to completion; later islands, vehicles and the ending are not yet verified.

pc-3ddotgameheroes.progress_basis: Per ps3kit's ports table: through the title screen, its demo play and FMOD's music to the first field, played at 30 frames.

pc-abelsmt.progress_basis: Per fmtownskit's ports table: the opening, the game and the ending play in a window, pixel for pixel against MAME where compared; saving and the English translation are still to do.

pc-doctorhauzer.progress_basis: Per 3dokit's ports table: the opening, the menu and the real-time 3D rooms play in the window with their music; no longer play is reported.

pc-escapefrommonstermanor.progress_basis: Per 3dokit's ports table: the first level plays in the window with its music; the monsters animate at twice the console's pace, the cel engine's time not yet charged.

pc-theneedforspeed.progress_basis: Per 3dokit's ports table: the films, the menus and the race at the console's speed and smooth; only the first race has been played.

pc-demolitionman.progress_basis: Per 3dokit's ports table: the attract loop runs through every kind of level for 100,000 fields; the first two shooting levels played with the mouse as the light gun.
